flavorEn: A gentle dinosaur who cares not for conflicts. Always with a smile towards an audience.
A ruthless tengu who leaves opponents stunned by attacking without mercy.
A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.
Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.
A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.
The newcomer of the Wooly Wonderland flock. A dyed-in-the-wool slacker.
A mid-level drone that spends most of its memory fighting for promotions. Its reports are a storm of peer-to-peer slander.
A ferocious plunderer that hunts under the cover of the moonlit night. Its razor sharp claws slice through its enemies!
A Harpie chick who aspires to flit about beautifully and gorgeously, but attack sharply.
Donpen was born in Antarctica and raised in Tokyo. He recently started Rush Dueling with Donko.   ©Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation
A malevolent creature wrapped in flames that attacks enemies with intense fire.
A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.
This girl is delicate no more. While poised and collected, she's always down to party. Pager pals with LaMoon the Party Princess.
The psychic menace has been growing in recent years, and a crack team of bodyguards has been entrusted to protect Psychic Diva, the key to solving it all.
A mass-produced mobile dismantler that's furnished with a multipurpose set of tools. Its limbs and wings are loosely fixed, so it often loses them.
An Elemental HERO with a clay body built-to-last. He'll preserve his Elemental HERO colleagues at any cost.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your hand face-up to your field.

flavorEn: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.
A Constructor Wyrm enveloped in specialized construction gear. It is said that no matter the size of the project, the wyrm could demolish the site in one blow.
A legendary samurai merman who received the divine blessing of the Hydro Sword. There is none that can see the sword fights that take place in the ocean depths.
Once this monster wraps itself around a victim, there is no escape.
A high-performance jet fighter with power capsules for variable attack capabilities.
Fight for the Light! Pure Finish!
A mystical dragon that burns away the unworthy with its mystic flames.
A crafting robot popular among children, who also serves as an amusement park mascot. Turn its central handle and it will transform.

requirementEn: When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they have 3 Attack Position monsters on their field.
effectEn: Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: The former familiar of a well-known magician. At some point its magical power surpassed that of its master, and it now toys with its foes by manipulating flames at will.

A spellcaster with a warm and genial heart that makes people around the world smile with her legendary magic, "Danish", that combines many arts and techniques. For her achievements, she's been given the title "Coco". She has a somewhat playful side, as she loves to dote on her companion "Maple".
This monster can hide just about anywhere by adopting the colors of its surroundings.
A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them.
Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.
An incarnation of the netherworld's sovereign, it claims the souls of the living and carries them to its realm. None may escape its violet edge.
Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

requirementEn: You have "Dark Magician" face-up on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: The poster-girl for a restaurant up North, an advocate for more work-life balance. Numerous corporate soldiers leave work on time to swing by, but she herself had also left on time.
A fiery mouse, travelling the world to become the strongest fighter in the world of mice. Be careful not to touch him, or you will get burned.
This small but deadly creature is better off avoided.
A crimson dragon that spits fireballs to create a blazing sea of fire.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Draw 3 cards. Then, send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

flavorEn: A mysterious life form from the ocean floor. It is said legendary sea serpents dwell in its habitat.
An ammonite warrior that has protected the seas throughout history.
This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.
A gargoyle enhanced by the powers of darkness. Very sharp talons make it a worthy opponent.
This clown appears from nowhere and executes very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.
A familiar said to hold great powers. It doesn't like being alone, and is very lonely now that it's been separated from its friends.
A wooden sword with a soul. It had passed through the hands of various souls and had witnessed the rise and fall of a century.
A golem with a massive right hand for crushing its victims.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: 1 face-up Level 7 or higher monster on your opponent's field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

flavorEn: Lurking in the shadows to support its master of the grass clan in battle. There is no doubt about her dedication.

requirementEn: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
effectEn: 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field gains 1000 ATK until the end of the turn.

flavorEn: A surprisingly strong armadillo that bounces back anything close. It can dig dexterously with its track belt.
A mechanical chair that is easy to mass produce. It is not as comfortable to sit in as the organic chairs from before.
An amphibian with a myriad of powers to shield it from enemy attacks.

en: Emperor of the Land and Sea
flavorEn: A reptilian monster that sprays fire in every direction.
A galactic warrior with no tolerance for villainry. Its strikes cleave apart even the deepest of darkness. Hideunri Va Yamerdei!
A flame manipulator who was the first Elemental HERO woman. Her Burstfire burns away villainy.
A female warrior who occupies a prison island as her primary battling grounds. She scolds with sword and shield in hand. Frequent repeaters have sent positive reviews of their awakening.
My favorite experiment is the flame test! I'll give it my all again today, driven by my burning spirit!
A monster so heavy that each step rocks the earth.
An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.
A sweet and bitter waitress. Preoccupied on whether to deliver your food or not.
These walls form a labyrinth with no exit for enemies.
Ants thanking each other for their support. They are determined to reproduce for more soldiers to thank.
Feel da strength ah dis sword-swingin' samurai from da Far East.
Known to many as the "Burning Executioner", this monster is capable of burning enemies to cinders.
Originally a pterodactyl, he was viciously attacked by a dragon. Using the newest technologies, his keeper saved him from near-fatal wounds and brought him back as a powerful Cyborg.
ey, dis mighty lissard man can swing his sword so fast, dat it's more dan da speed a sound!
Overcoming every noodle-front and steadily evolving, the leader of the Noodle Ninja Clan. Unbound by status or noodle identity, he reaches out to members without noodle awareness.
Who knew adding Mont Blanc cakes to a clay pot would grant it with a soul. The sight of them roaming the stilt houses are met with screams beyond surprise.

A beast that drives around wildly, always in search of some fun. He is petty, and only picks fights he thinks he can win, so he often falls to unexpected counterattacks. He grows uninhibited when he's got friends around, which leads to misunderstandings, and he still hasn't figured out that he can't do anything on his own.
The most buoyant of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It always remains serene and laid-baaack.
A magician with a flaring passion. A passion that will eventually turn his heart into ash.
A flower spirit that never abandons her beloved. She is always happy.
A small peace-loving dragon that will affectionately approach you if fed some nuts. The ring on its necklace is rumored to hold a great secret.

en: Princess of the Flock - Miss Mutton
flavorEn: Baa-dum, baa-dum, baa-dum, baa-dum, baaaaa-dum! The sheep's in the meadow, the cow's in the corn! You can call me "miss", but I'm actually Wooly Wonderland royalty. I'm never sheepish about chowing on paper (even if it happens to be an important letter).
This amphibian is strong on the attack, but leaves much to be desired when defending.
A man who carries the power of an evil star. He charges across the battlefield each day, filled with faith in his own sense of justice.
The gatekeeper standing watch over the path to the Fire Dragon Kingdom. Those who cannot withstand its breath do not have the right to go past it.
Even scholars argue whether this mysterious creature is a bird or a beast. When flying in swarms, they somewhat resemble dragons, so it is possible that's what they are.
A space weapon whose structure resembles a spiral galaxy. It attacks with highly maneuverable appendages. Wuhjah!
This long-tailed bird blinds its enemies with mystical light.
A sword with a soul. It is said that those who held this sword had begun training for an inevitable battle.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Machine Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A ferocious panda chef. Gets quite upset when you order Panna Cotta.

A beast continually looting citizens of their food and gasoline. He might appear to be a lone wolf, but he believes that evil is right and does everything he can for his gang. For such a wicked criminal, one can't help but wonder why his distant howls touch the heart so deeply.
A rhymester representin' the riverside. He stirs up passersby who approach the water.
While the king is away, this queen protects his throne with a mighty defense.
A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.
A girl who has trouble making eye contact when talking with others. She seeks friends and true love.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Destroy 1 Attack Position monster with the highest ATK on the field.

flavorEn: This club-wielding warrior battles to the end and will never surrender.

requirementEn: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a Level 7 or higher monster face-up.
effectEn: Gain 1000 LP. Then, you can make 1 face-up Aqua Type monster on your field gain 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Gain 1000 LP.

flavorEn: A monster with a head of poison snakes. One look from this monster can turn an opponent to stone.
A beast soldier derived from dragons, it is small for a Dragon Type. Moving very quickly, this monster is an excellent strategist.

requirementEn: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
effectEn: Destroy 1 monster on the field.

flavorEn: The heart on its back is the trademark for this tender ladybug. It is said that love will come true with a touch.

requirementEn: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.
effectEn: 1 face-up Normal Monster on your field with 1000 or less ATK gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

flavorEn: A dragon that lives in cold territories. It moves at high speeds through snowy paths.
An extremely long snake that dwells in the world of myth.
A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.
A ferocious being in a world of fire. The devoured pray leaves not a single bone.
In possession of infinite potential. Chasing her dreams with a smile that blinds.
A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.
This ethereal dragon carries the hopes of many an innocent star. Its attacks draw strength by resonating with the pure of heart. Ungoldo Guwahi!
A cosmic creature who controls an asteroid-like UFO to move through space. Jubidogew Higewmei!
A dragon child with hidden potential. It dreams of those goggles that show a vast virtual world.
A meteoric swordsman with powers unknown, who paves the way for a miraculous path.
This dragon feeds on emerald. Enchanted by this monster even when attacked, few people live to tell of its beauty.
A powerful monster whose two heads attack as one.
The free-roamer of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It remains blase even while others around are venting.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Destroy all monsters on the field.

flavorEn: The youngest member of the band, she's often teased by Romic n' Roller, but everyone recognizes her talents. She dreams of the day she'll play on stage with her bandmates as a quintet.
A presence passes behind your back in the basement of the boy's bathroom. But you cannot turn around until you have finished your business. There is no return for an early peek...
A baseball warrior with a deft lead and an arrow-like delivery. Also known as the bedrock, he leads his teammates with his passionate play style.
A now "rich" dinosaur who had changed names in exchange for luck. He used to live in a hole.
A messenger who illuminates the way to the higher realm. Darkness flees against the light of the chosen.
A rookie angel who reads out letters from a flying radio. The first is a letter from Radio Name: Mr. Corrupt Hermit.
A playmate for children of the underworld. Though it is a hard worker, it eats any paper it sees. As its ward grows into an adult, its magical power also grows.

en: Count of the White Dwarf, St. Tremain
flavorEn: A count who has been rumored to live for over 300 years. Immediately after he gets a haircut, he cannot fire his lasers.

en: The Twin Dragons of the Heavens
flavorEn: Noble and majestic lights that pervade the heavens and earth throughout all eternity. They move based on the logic of the divine, calmly wielding majesty and authority.
One of the earliest organic chairs said to be made by a family of artisans. Has a distinctive feel when sat upon.
An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.
A pure and innocent flower spirit. It gently responds to the desires of its Lord that believes in it.
A flying dragon with four wings housing some very dangerous blades.
The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.
A gigantic ant creature covered by thick armor. It will crush those that had forsaken the forest.
This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.
A minor dragon incapable of breathing fire.
A ninja who is proud of his chewy noodles and their unique texture. Those bound by his soup-infused noodles cannot escape.
This dragon appeared from the sky and crashed to the earth.
The incarnation of darkness that deceives and corrupts one's mind. It eats away at everything.
An extremely shy flower spirit. Her sweet sigh is invigorating.
A beaver with the fiend's sauce and plate. It attacks by shoving the top ranked meat list down your throat.
A swordswoman who leads the vanguard in the entertainment district. Even in full makeup, she always carries her sword and shield. Friends with Bubbly Elf.
A beautiful mermaid that lures voyagers to a watery grave.
An ancient tank that drives with incredible balance. It shatters the balance of the enemy forces by penetrating a single point.
Delivers the morning edition before breakfast! Also delivers the evening edition before breakfast!

requirementEn: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
effectEn: Destroy all face-up monsters on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A broom with a soul. It is said that whoever wields this broom will begin to work harder towards their goals.
A free-spirited creature inhabiting an eruptive crater. The flames from its body can ignite a sea of fire, but it is not bothered by mere infernal walls.
Equipped with a multipurpose shovel, this police robot can simultaneously carry out field work and security duties.
A battle anthem valkyrie who once flourished in Heaven. Her rainbow-colored shield reads and reflects any attack.
Sisters known for their warping abilities and unusual posture. The three of them love cruising alongside spaceships and surprising the pilots.
A star cat with eyes of gold. They're filled with charm.
She bends water to her will, hardening sand into stone. With muddy hands, She brings all sorts of creations to life.
Imbued with energy from a crescent moon, this warrior fends off every attack with a monumental shield. Its inner power awakens with the arrival of the full moon.
An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.
She is a gentle spirit who plays the harp at recitals. Her melody soothes every soul.
A product developed to relieve the food shortage. Its sweet appearance and taste are drawing excited cheers.
An iron wolf with razor-sharp fangs that can penetrate any armor.
Lurking in the shadows to save its master of the grass clan from danger. Even after its defeat, it will return from behind the grassy knoll.
A horse kind of man. No one can catch up to his gorging speed.
A surprisingly fast hippopotamus that tries to push back any hostility. It can swim dexterously with its track belt.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Sea Serpent Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.
A gentle but powerful and trustworthy creature that stands in the background. It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.''
A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.
An exquisite dragon covered in fire. It does not like fights, but still has incredibly high attack power.
Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.
A proud ruler of the jungle that some fear and others respect.
A designer that uses her psychic talents to make costumes for shows. She is stubborn and won't accept jobs from artists she doesn't like.
A sorceress that has escaped dull, everyday life. She uses lunar magic to captivate affluent men. Besties with Kanan the Sword Diva.
This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.
Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Seeking a route to a utopia, this soldier pushes forth without relent.

She is the princess of "Coco", a kingdom overflowing with happiness, and is adored by all for her gentle personality. She brings smiles to those that arrive and blesses those who depart. She has a strong bond with her attendants "Caramel" and "Whip".
Though often considered a relative of birds, this mysterious creature is something else entirely. Its strength resembles that of a dragon more than a bird, so it is possible that's what it is.

The tiny star dragon has grown and taken on a new form. Fueled by its bonds with people and the power of the stars, it contains a mysterious power within its body. When the fated hour comes, its name will be engraved in the star sanctuary.
The jack of all trades in the band. The gentle melody fills weight in each swing. The top of the head glows when excited.
The linchpin of the band. She commands her characterful comrades with deft motions of her rod. Say anything about her glasses and she'll stir up a storm.
A mechanical doll that has no emotional expression other than a smile. The emotional response from the audience is its main source of energy.
A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.
The eldest Grace Princess sister. She adores Kana.
An amphibian that sold his soul for unlimited power to avenge his late friend.
A treasure box containing a monster that attacks any unwary bandit.
A plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.
While normally calm, this is one mutt you don't want to cross. His motivation? So-so.
An unfathomably strong beetle species. They often lock horns with others, competing for dark sap.
A tired old fish that can't seem to get rid of his aches.
A sorcerer whose hands have been tainted by the forbidden arts. He does not yet know the price for the power he desired.
What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.
An individual imbued with the power of a wicked celestial being. Looks up to Echeclus the Star Knight as one would a mentor.
He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.
A star cat with eyes of silver. They're filled with wonder.

One day, the curse of the Blightblaze was unleashed. Some pray for the resurrection of the fallen king, while others pray to the Blightblaze itself. Will the land either know salvation or face Armageddon as a result of these various desires?
The apex of the Mean Mutts who presides over his clumsy so-so subordinates. His proficiency is quite woofderful.
The heart and soul of the band. Her dynamic tones make her an excellent solo fighter, but she needs help to equip the weapon on her left arm.
A jersey-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.
A baseball warrior with gutsy defense and surprising hitting range. Also known as the fence magician, he is remembered visually rather than statistically.
The source of the draconic tree that holds the secret of all providence. When assailed by microcosm and macrocosm, the world will be guided to a new domain.
A multifaceted older brother type. It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.''
A jet-powered hawk that travels at the speed of sound.  (This card is not treated as a "Cyber" card.)
A surface battle robot that was once used for sea warfare.

A ferocious serpent that was being hunted by Atlanteans. Battle-weary and ragged, it came upon an ancient light, and gained new strength for its battle. With its increased power, it launched an invasion of enemy territory with a renewed assault.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.
A dragon that made seven supernovae go gamma-ray burst. Its name is... The Dragias! The Dragias!!
This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent.

flavorEn: Say, "Ahh!"

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on the field.

flavorEn: A dragon egg with countless hidden account information. It dreams of connecting to a brand new world, counting down to the time it awakens.
A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those who passed away in battle.
This monster's tough hide deflects almost any attack.
An angelic ballerina who never spares effort. Even through harsh training, she presses on with unwavering determination.
A rust-free machine warrior born to battle.
A specialist in spacecraft design and maintenance. Currently assisting with an outlandish project at a certain facility.
Using the spikes sprouting from its body, this creature stabs its opponents and floods them with electricity.
A guitar that has descended to the lower realm. The tones it plays are angelic.
An anglerfish with evolved electric organs. Attacks enemies with sharp fangs and electric shocks.
A guitar fiend that works hard every day to get everyone to hear its songs.
A famous shield said to belong to an ancient Egyptian Pharaoh. Legends tell of its power to block any strong attack.
A drill instructor for the Fire Dragon Kingdom's elite strike forces. The scorching heat he releases sweeps away those who would harm the king.
An angelic waitress that sets tables and trends. Will not surrender to evil wills nor to the changes of the latest "thing".
A sign of divine will that dances and sings glory. Lead those who have assembled together towards an unparalleled stage.

A canine that extorts scraps of dog food from an old man. He is full of himself and acts tough, but has no real convictions. He used to hate living life on a leash, but now he feels that he was happier just to have an owner.
An aggressive mermaid who disciplines those sent to the abyss. Frequent repeaters have sent positive reviews for forgiveness.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Plant Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A respecter of tradition that reminisces about times long past. Those really were the good old days.
An enigmatic man who never speaks of his past. His baton wielding shakes the crowd wild, as if it were magic.
The origin of the dragon tree, connected to a different curiosity. With its concealed infinite branches, it unfolds into unknown worlds.
An ox monster with a fine tongue and a hefty intestine. Grills everything on a single skewer.
A dragon that spawned from an underground mineral vein. It uses the energy from an unknown ore as a power source for battling. The ultra-hard blows it delivers are incredibly effective!
The most lambent of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It conducts the others' activities, always with a twinkle in its eye.
A deformed fiend under servitude to the king. It swallows all sound and deflects all bombardment.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Thunder Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: Elf twins that alternate their attacks.
Fight for the Light! Good Night!
A bass fiend that coolly supports Beginitar and Kidrum.
A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.
Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.
A pterosaur that glides through the room with its vibrant wings, capturing the hearts of children.
A living ball of desires, he criticizes others, but not himself. He's that kind of hermit.
From lost cats to dignitary protection, she's a multifaceted troubleshooter. Lately its been all lunch deliveries, but out of nowhere, she receives a message from an unknown sender.
The elder of the Wooly Wonderland flock. It tries to ram through its decisions but the others refuse to be herded.

requirementEn: When your opponent Normal Summons a monster.
effectEn: Draw 2 cards.

flavorEn: A flying mantis that feeds primarily on insects.
A cutesy chameleon with an affinity for anything adorable. She keeps her latest fav stowed in her mouth all day long.
A specialist in safety assurance. Due to his work, he often finds himself looking down, but his character is positive and kind.
A charming serpent that's super sociable. It performs a slithery dance to the tune of a flute, turning spectators' frowns upside down.
An infant Dragon of the four elemental dragons. Protects the land by manipulating the atmosphere at will.
A crony of the divine beings from the Celestial Sushi Dimension. With wit and sweet paddy-feels, decrees for rice rolls-off the tongue.
Here comes a magma-hot shiatsu massage! Pressure Point Eruption!
The mystic links of this chain can rob enemies of their power.
A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.
Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!
A bird that releases bombs. There may be little people inside.
Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks, this creature is particularly effective in mountain battles.
A fast and lethal creature with very dangerous claws.

requirementEn: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A crony of the divine beings from the Celestial Sushi Dimension. With wit and aromatic paddy-feels, decrees for rice rolls-off the tongue.
This body vaporizes and burns. So long as my fighting spirit endures, I shall remain immortal.
A little lady warrior whose stage is the drama club. With sword and shield in hand, she floats lightly and dances gracefully.
An exploration satellite that emerged from the far reaches of darkness. It harbors a dark power that transcends causality.
Ants that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.
An axe-wielding warrior. He has pushed himself to the limit in honing his body. The attacks from the two axes he brandishes are quite powerful.
A mysterious life form born from the final spark. Energy emanating from its cracks carries a will of its own. Hyudury Vaza Vizy!
The 84th model of the GA-type aircraft, commonly known as Tagayashi. It boasts superior aeronautical performance and extensive agricultural functionality.
A mermaid archer that hides in a protective shell, waiting for the right moment to strike.
A dragon formed by huge boulders that are also used to attack the enemy.
The beams from the eyes of this creature are said to turn enemies into zombies.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: 1 face-up WIND Attribute monster with 2000 or more ATK on your field loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn. Then, you can destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: This legendary samurai  is a veteran of over a hundred battles.

requirementEn: When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
effectEn: Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on the field.

flavorEn: Although it hatched without any exact plan, it's always ready to roll.
A clutch player for the team. No matter what flies at him, he will risk his life to stop it.
A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.
A dinosaur living peacefully in a herd. Although its form is intimidating, it's not really that strong.
Which came first, space or the egg? This girl has an explosive imagination.
A successor of old gods. Skilled at hiding, few know of their existence.
An invincible fist that could split a mountain. The flaring battle flag burns within its chest. There is no defeat in the ultimate battle.
The star on its back is the trademark for this emotional ladybug. Today, it delivers joy and rainbow trails to all.
After many years dormant, it has set out once more to devour lifeforms across the cosmos. It invades domain after domain via the interdimensional portals that surround it.
The vanguard of the band. She creates beautiful melodies by swinging her axes through the air. Some believe she chooses her outfit to hide her weaponry, but it's just because she gets cold easily.
A white cat with blue eyes. Said to bring good luck if treated well.
A young investigator who protects the peace in the city. She is struggling to solve a certain disappearance case.
A lady warrior armed with sword and shield, she floats lightly and stings sharply.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Gain 500 LP.

en: Fazuzu the King of Mythical Wind Beasts
flavorEn: A Mythical Beast with 2 pairs of wings. It has been safeguarding the Royal City in silence.
This monster swamps an opponent with an almost endless supply of water.

requirementEn: When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
effectEn: Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: An ant who is oppressed, but believes it will have freedom someday.
The subleader of Max Firepower. His beloved super-high-powered flamethrower, obtained recently, came at the cost of his life savings. Let it burn!
A flying dragon that can transform itself freely. By logging the enemy's movement, it performs the most optimal update for itself.
A mechanical soldier that won't stop attacking until all life readings have been extinguished from its sensors.

requirementEn: When an opponent's monster declares an attack.
effectEn: Destroy the attacking monster.

flavorEn: A winged Elemental HERO who wheels through the sky and manipulates the wind. His signature move, Featherbreak, gives villainy a blow from sky-high.
Popular, unique, and always energetic. It sends out its sounds every day with the belief that it will find friends it can resonate with.''
Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.
A veteran warrior. He uses six types of rollers in his work, but laymen cannot tell the difference between them.
A magician who inhabits a pure and innocent soul. Those clear eyes were said to see all reason, but as time passed, he began to hide them behind a mask.
The keystone of the Sky Emperor, bestowed with the providence of all existence. By breaking through its constraints, it is born anew to break new ground.
Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Endeavoring to erect a utopia, this soldier tackles one layer at a time.
A spirit of the forest powered by the surrounding trees and wildlife.
Blows kisses that leave you tingling. They get the feeling across.
An Electro organism dwelling inside network circuits. They do not enjoy conflicts and would eat bugs to resolve it.
An autonomous robot with a knack for building things. No one yet knows the power embedded in its joints.
A black cat with red eyes. Said to bring bad luck to those around it.
Found in humid regions, this creature attacks enemies with a lethal rain of poison spores.
A train fueled by tips to catch the earliest scoop. Fact-checks and deadlines are eaten for breakfast!
A plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword. Surprisingly baked.
A young warrior. Each day he passionately uses his shovel to dig up work sites.
A ninja who prides himself on being al dente. He constantly trains himself to reach the hardness of steel wire. He isn't great with water techniques.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Galaxy Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A Mean Mutt who threatens with a throaty deep voice. His ability to intimidate others is... so-so.
It pings its position to others by emitting electromagnetic waves. Audiences gather from all around to witness its fantastic trunk tricks.
The Aliens have used a mysterious biological substance to create a supreme race of soldiers. They do not have the natural powers of the other Aliens, but can make stunning physical attacks.

The Sales and Happiness Manager of Kumamoto Prefecture. His job is to help people across the country find surprises and happiness all around them. TV Tokyo's corporate banana, Nanana, can't hide their shock and surprise at Kumamon's happy aura.''   ©2010kumamoto pref.kumamon
The Commander of Machine Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.
A member of the faction of the grass ninja who sneak in the shadows, always watching over their lord. She performs her ninja duties with lightning fast speed and then disappears like a puff of smoke.

en: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
flavorEn: This monster moves so fast that it looks like an illusion to mortal eyes.
A tortoise born from an unhinged project proposal. Some assumed the tortoise maneuvers through outer space with its boosters.
The veteran of the band. She provides her allies with resounding support. The impressive progress of the young Tubardiche gives her hope for the future.
A researcher of the nature of darkness. He serves a king who seeks to conquer the continent, but his true aims are unknown.
With innocent eyes that melt hearts, this cutie slips right past enemy defenses. His loyalty? So-so.
A sorcerer that draws its powers from the lunar landscape.
The peacemaker among monsters.
A novice drone that continues to update itself through trial & error. Frantically on the clock.
This Spellcaster attacks enemies with fire-related spells such as "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".
Yo, this tyrannosaurus tot's got a terrible temper.
This mutated mouse dwells in the core of active volcanoes. No amount of heat is too much for it to bear.
This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.
This human-shaped animal with wings is beautiful to watch but deadly in battle.
A gear beast designed for combat. Its doggedness awakens the ultimate fighting bravery.
A giant dragon that has a stately sheen. Its scales are said to grant the wishes of those who obtain them.
A leading light in the field of combustion research. Fiercely proud of his gloves, which come in handy any time something needs turning to ash.
A knight who wanders the cosmos in search of worthy opponents. Quindoragewomai Guindulijimai!
Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.
The glittering glow of the conquering king that rules over tens of thousands of stars. Once one reaches the highest heights, its true form will be revealed.
A drum fiend that started a band because it admired the greater Royal Rebels.

en: The Thing In the Purple Mirror
flavorEn: Folks...do you know the term "purple mirror"? If you know, be careful. If you remember it passed 20 years, then you...
A girl that sings her feelings freely. The love will never fade away.
This free-wheeling gravity-defier tears across the stars. These days he can be found weaving amid the crowd of grown-ups on interplanetary street. Izundewmo Idohshowar!
Of all Insect fighters, he is the paragon of the Indestructible Insect Invaders, which only the elite of the elite can join. We can no longer ignore their unmatched battle prowess.
Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

requirementEn: You have "Dark Magician" face-up on your field.
effectEn: Destroy all Spell/Trap Cards on your opponent's field.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Level 7 or higher Dragon Type Normal Monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy all face-up Level 6 or lower monsters on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.
A fish with a proboscis that heats up when attacking. Its mild flavor makes it a true delicacy.
—Gloria in Luce. With the sound of majestic hoof beats, he will tread through the afterglow to show the path to supremacy.''

A bird that constantly emits sound as it flies with the wind. It is said the noise its wings make reflects the heart of the listener. To some it sounds like a beautiful song, but to others it's an ominous drone.
A mammoth that protects the graves of its pack and is absolutely merciless when facing grave-robbers.
A baseball warrior with weight behind his swing. Also known as the marauding captain, he aggressively swings from the first pitch.
A young wizard who can communicate telepathically with water. His brilliant blue dance leaves his foes in awe.
Materializes alongside a flash of lightning. This electric creature can zap through machinery to short-circuit their being.
I always get sleep paralysis while sleeping in my dressing room... And inside that the dark, when I look towards my pillow...
He fights back with water guns against any foe. Trust from his allies? So-so.
A dragon of justice that makes you envision a supernova clash! The name is, The Dragon!
Incredibly useful on site, but the lease is exorbitant. Planning is the biggest part of the job.
A curious explorer and an apprentice adventurer. She is often found hanging about the Prophecy Phrase who are searching for their ancestral treasures.
The most pensive of the Wooly Wonderland flock. Something of a black sheep, it prefers to stick to its own knitting.
A dolphin that has braved the stormy seas and hardships of the world, throwing itself headfirst into learning the ways of royalty.

Duel Dimension System activated- Born in the Sea of Neuron, a proud swordswoman who journeyed across nine dimensions. Her blade, wielded alongside countless Duelists, is not meant to sever, but to unite.  People's hope link beyond time and space.''
An acrobat who soars freely through the air. She adds a gorgeous sense of flair to the show together with her younger sister, Evil Bowler.
A wandering warrior who seeks the sanctuary where he can gain the power of the Archlords. To escape the temptation of evil fiends, he fights solo day by day.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Cyberse Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A civil engineering machine specializing in excavation. It bounces up and down as it plows the earth.
A masterpiece organic chair made by a family of artisans at the peak of their craft. Extremely comfortable.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Dragon Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.
A member of a race of Sea Serpents that freely travels through the sea.

en: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
flavorEn: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.
An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.
Spawned from cosmic chaos, this soldier serves a malicious deity. If its merciless eye fixes upon you, you will know the true meaning of fear.
An instrument of conquest controlled by 5 rings. It reduces the civilizations in its path to mere dust. Duguyahi Bu Zuwahi!
A dragon knight leading a dark army. His merciless attacks have unparalleled strength, and the cursed sword he wields devours the souls of his foes and makes him stronger.
Armed with a pair of shovels, this monster will destroy anything that stands in its way.
An organism formed from jellyfish and electrical plugs. It is an ecological enigma.
A spellcaster who has devoted himself to the heavens. He is wreathed in divine blessings, but what fate awaits him?
This weakened dragon can no longer fly, but is still a deadly force to be reckoned with.
Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.
A warrior protected by a flaming shield that nullifies any attack.
A samurai who claims to be from the far east. The bread knife in his hand cuts well.
These creatures can be found everywhere in the sea. Despite overfishing in recent years, their numbers show no sign of decreasing.
A maiden who freely drifts around the Milky Way like a shooting star. Countless people make wishes on her, but she dryly states that real dreams are the ones you can fulfill on your own.
A professional with an understanding that the world is either sweet or sour. Any dish she treats will be seasoned with perfection.
A mysterious creature that has fortified its delicate hide with meteorites to protect itself from cosmic carnivores. Egyahi Du Uvahi!
A dragon created from a massive diamond that sparkles with blinding light.
A new Elemental HERO has arrived from Neo-Space! When he initiates a Contact Fusion with a Neo-Spacian his unknown powers are unleashed.
A beast that has refused divine protection, exchanging tranquility for freedom.
A young galactic warrior birthed from the Milky Way itself. It takes in enormous amounts of energy from the stars as it battles. Gyanahri Du Zuwahi!
This beautiful Dragon spirit harbors hidden strength.
An angel living it up in the present progressive tense. No one can stop this maaan.
A music weapon that fell from heaven. Its special sound waves that it releases are as sharp as a laser.
This creature uses jet propulsion to charge in shocking speeds. Some wonder whether it even is a fish.
An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.
A digital beast that transports information through the network world. Through generations of modification, it has evolved into a creature with a straightforward and honest nature.
This machine, created to lead charges into enemy territory, mows down enemies by rushing.
A whimsical flower spirit. Her cheers are small, but full of feelings.
Although he fled his hometown one fateful day, this sorcerer still harbors unshakable pride in his clan.

en: Heartless Hound Striking Kai Ken Knuckle
flavorEn: A young Mean Mutt who is extremely motivated, but also pretty reckless. The strength of his grip is... so-so.

requirementEn: You have a face-up Spellcaster Type monster on your field.
effectEn: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on your opponent's field.

flavorEn: A magical sword that uses a flame spirit puppet to wield itself. It is said that the sword recognizes the one who can best the flame spirit as its true wielder.
A galactic warrior who guards order. It charges at extreme speed to rescue allies from danger, leaving a jet of light in its wake. Migui Gyaran Gonaidewei!
A young priestess from a bloodline of ancient dragons. She offers daily prayers for the peace of her people. It is said her clear eyes have the power to alter the fate of those reflected in them.
A marvelous dragon that lives beneath the clear waters. He is now the popular mascot of a circus.
An informant with a big-sisterly personality. She helps Bandijo's gang on their quest to discover their tribe's secrets.
An ictiostega warrior with surprising toughness. But the weight of their hard armor makes them sluggish.
New encounters, new adventures, a new world. A new road for the dragon whelp that turns zero into one.
Slime formed from interstellar gaseous matter. Smells faintly of lime. Iyashgewei!
A Blisstopian princess of Wyrms who deeply values her bonds with her friends.
A young bowman loved by the wind. His arrows are made from magic and fly endlessly.
An Dragonic Anthropo reborn from a soul of a Dragon He exhibits a high level of agility and intelligence, and wields a tablet used as a sword or shield.
A humanoid reincarnated from a dragon. His masterful strategy and deft hands help reduce construction times considerably.
A galactic warrior who attacks by launching saucers. Igyah Du Zuwahi!

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Gain 400 LP.

flavorEn: Before the dawn of man, this lizard warrior ruled supreme.
Demolish, construct, demolish, construct... Striving to reach a utopia, this soldier aims ever higher.

requirementEn: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
effectEn: Special Summon 1 Dragon Type monster from your hand face-up to your field.

flavorEn: A zombie that is constantly swaying awkwardly. He has no consciousness, but his body cannot forget the beat of the samba.
Inspired by the wind, he is devoted to freedom above all else. However, his willful ways will end up leading him down a path that limits his liberty.
A Super Soldier that appears due to Black Luster Jersitual. He cuts through his enemies with his deadly Chaos Elastic Slash.
A pterodactyl that loves to collect shiny objects. The shell atop of its head, is its favorite.
An elusive assassin who undertakes dangerous missions while searching for her lost partner.
Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.
The days and months flowed by. Each day was full. Those really were the good old days.
A skilled swordsmen that had once served a powerful nation. His sword flies through with unrivaled precision as the crowd holds their breath.
Swallows enemies whole and uses their essence as energy.

requirementEn: None
effectEn: Draw 2 cards.

flavorEn: Its power source is AA Batteries. Its daily routine is to watch videos while taking a walk. It never works or studies.
Adventurers in search of lands unknown. They used to compete how far they could fly, but became traveling companions before long.
